title: Twelve Horny Women
cn: 第 8 集 · 十二个饥渴女人
novel: Marshall took on Brad in the biggest case of his career. Brad had betrayed him by joining the opposing side in a major [[environmental|environmental]] lawsuit. Marshall felt [[devastated|devastate]] that his friend had turned against him. The case was about a company that was [[polluting|pollute]] the local river. Marshall was determined to win and protect the environment. The trial was [[intense|intense]] and both sides fought hard. Brad used personal information about Marshall to try to win the case. Marshall was angry but stayed focused on the [[evidence|evidence]]. Meanwhile, the gang recalled their past run-ins with the law. They each shared stories about times they had gotten into trouble. Ted talked about a time he was caught [[trespassing|trespass]] on private property. Robin shared a story about being arrested during a protest. Barney bragged about his many encounters with the police. Lily told a story about getting a parking ticket that turned into a huge mess. They all laughed about their [[ridiculous|ridiculous]] experiences with the law. Back at the trial, Marshall delivered a powerful closing argument. He spoke [[passionately|passionate]] about protecting the environment for future generations. The jury was moved by his words. In the end, Marshall won the case and felt [[vindicated|vindicate]]. He had proven that he was a good lawyer and a good person.

pollute.en: to make something dirty or harmful
